communitySubmitFeedback.title: Trimite feedback pentru produs sau lot

examples.python:
import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
payload = json.loads('{"trade_item_id": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "product_info_version_id": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", "kind": "review", "text": "Observație despre produs.", "rating": 4, "consent": true, "submission_key": "exemplu-feedback-001"}')
data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
request = urllib.request.Request('https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/community/feedback', data=data, headers=headers, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    raise

application/json.description: ID-ul articolului comercial (ambalare/variantă); diferă de produs și de GTIN.

request = urllib.request.Request('https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/manage/feedback/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/moderate', data=data, headers=headers, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:

except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
